title: Dual Optical Mapping of Action Potentials and Calcium Transients in the Mouse Heart
author: Pradeep Rajendran
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bcdtis6n
materials: Hearts were stained with bolus injections of voltage-sensitive RH237 (30uL of 1mg/mL in DMSO, Thermo Fisher Scientific, S1109) and Ca indicator Rhod-2 AM (30uL of 1mg/ml in DMSO, Biotium, 50024) into the coronary perfusate.

steps.title: Euthanize animal and excise heart
steps.instruction: Euthanize the animal using an IACUC‑approved method, open the chest, and remove the heart and lungs.

steps.title: Cannulate aorta in ice‑cold Tyrode’s
steps.instruction: Prepare ice‑cold Tyrode’s solution (112 mM NaCl, 5 mM KCl, 25 mM NaHCO₃, 1 mM KH₂PO₄, 1.2 mM MgSO₄, 1.8 mM CaCl₂, 50 mM glucose). Quickly cannulate the aorta onto a Langendorff apparatus to perfuse the coronary vessels, completing cannulation within 10 minutes of euthanasia.

steps.title: Mount heart on Langendorff and immobilize
steps.instruction: Connect the heart to the Langendorff system; perfuse at either constant coronary pressure or constant flow rate as desired. Place the heart in a custom‑built chamber to immobilize it and reduce motion artifact.

steps.title: Set up excitation illumination
steps.instruction: Turn on the 100‑W tungsten lamp, collimate the light, pass it through a 530 ± 30 nm interference filter, split the beam with a 560 nm dichroic mirror, and focus the excitation light onto the dorsal epicardial surface of the heart.

substeps.instruction: Split beam with 560 nm dichroic mirror
Focus illumination onto dorsal epicardial surface

steps.title: Configure emission collection optics
steps.instruction: Collect emitted fluorescence with tandem camera lenses (50 mm f/1.2 Nikon and 50 mm f/0.95 Navitar), split the emission with a 600 nm dichroic mirror, filter the longer‑wavelength (Vm) channel between 610–750 nm, and filter the shorter‑wavelength (Ca²⁺) channel between 570–595 nm.

substeps.instruction: Collect fluorescence with tandem lenses (50 mm f/1.2 Nikon, 50 mm f/0.95 Navitar)
Split emission with 600 nm dichroic mirror
Apply 610–750 nm filter for Vm channel
Apply 570–595 nm filter for Ca²⁺ channel

steps.title: Align cameras and set acquisition parameters
steps.instruction: Mount two CMOS cameras (SciMedia MiCAM ULTIMA). Set sampling rate to 2 kHz, image size to 100 × 100 pixels, field of view to 5 × 5 mm (pixel resolution 150 × 150 µm²).

steps.title: Apply electrical stimulation protocol
steps.instruction: Stimulate the dorsal heart at 10 Hz, 10 ms pulse width, delivering 221 mW for 10 seconds. Do not use excitation‑contraction uncoupling agents such as blebbistatin.

steps.title: Acquire and record optical data
steps.instruction: Record data in 40‑second intervals: capture 15 seconds baseline before stimulation, 10 seconds during stimulation, and 15 seconds after stimulation.
